name: animatedModal
description: animatedModal.js is a jQuery plugin to create a fullscreen modal with CSS3 transitions. you can use the transitions by animate.css or create yourself their transitions.

scripts.build:types: mkdir -p dist && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/index.d.ts', 'declare const animatedModal: any;\nexport default animatedModal;\n')"
scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types

author: João Pereira
